INPUTS = {'documents/team 0/memo 00.txt': 'Document number 0\n', 'documents/team 0/memo 01.txt': 'Document number 1\n', 'documents/team 0/memo 02.txt': 'Document number 2\n', 'documents/team 0/memo 03.txt': 'Document number 3\n', 'documents/team 1/memo 04.txt': 'Document number 4\n', 'documents/team 1/memo 05.txt': 'Document number 5\n', 'documents/team 1/memo 06.txt': 'Document number 6\n', 'documents/team 1/memo 07.txt': 'Document number 7\n', 'documents/team 2/memo 08.txt': 'Document number 8\n', 'documents/team 2/memo 09.txt': 'Document number 9\n', 'documents/team 2/memo 10.txt': 'Document number 10\n', 'documents/team 2/memo 11.txt': 'Document number 11\n', 'documents/team 3/memo 12.txt': 'Document number 12\n', 'documents/team 3/memo 13.txt': 'Document number 13\n', 'documents/team 3/memo 14.txt': 'Document number 14\n', 'documents/team 3/memo 15.txt': 'Document number 15\n', 'documents/.policy.txt': 'internal retention policy\n', 'config/document-list.txt': 'team 0/memo 00.txt\nteam 0/memo 02.txt\nteam 1/memo 04.txt\nteam 1/memo 06.txt\nteam 2/memo 08.txt\nteam 2/memo 10.txt\nteam 3/memo 12.txt\nteam 3/memo 14.txt\n.policy.txt\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/backup_documents.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1, 2)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    before=tree('documents')
    put('backup box/keep.txt','retain\n');run('documents','config/document-list.txt','backup box')
    want={p:before[p] for p in INPUTS['config/document-list.txt'].splitlines()}
    assert tree('backup box') == {**want,'keep.txt':'retain\n'}
    assert tree('documents') == before
    put('new list.txt','\nteam 0/memo 01.txt\n\nteam 3/memo 15.txt')
    run('documents','new list.txt','another backup')
    assert tree('another backup') == {p:before[p] for p in ['team 0/memo 01.txt','team 3/memo 15.txt']}
    put('empty list.txt','\n');run('documents','empty list.txt','empty backup')
    assert (root/'empty backup').is_dir() and tree('empty backup') == {}
    put('overwrite backup/team 0/memo 00.txt','stale\n')
    run('documents','config/document-list.txt','overwrite backup')
    assert tree('overwrite backup') == want
    assert tree('documents') == before
    assert get('config/document-list.txt') == INPUTS['config/document-list.txt']

files.scripts/backup_documents.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
src=$1
list=$2
dst=$3
mkdir -p "$dst"
while IFS= read -r relative || [ -n "$relative" ]; do
  [ -n "$relative" ] || continue
  mkdir -p "$dst/$(dirname "$relative")"
  cp "$src/$relative" "$dst/$relative"
done < "$list"
